subject: Genetics
title: Gene Duplication
description: A fast breakdown of Gene Duplication for builders.

hook.text: What if a gene copied itself? Now you have two copies. One can stay essential. The other is free to evolve.

buildup.text: Gene duplication happens during DNA replication errors. The extra copy faces no selective pressure to stay the same.

discovery.text: Human color vision evolved from gene duplication. One opsin gene duplicated, then mutated to detect new wavelengths.

twist.text: The globin gene family—alpha, beta, fetal—all came from one ancient gene that duplicated and specialized over millions.

climax.text: Duplication is evolution's copy-paste. It creates raw material for new functions without losing the original.

punchline.text: Evolution innovates by copying first, then editing.

quiz.question: How did human color vision evolve?
options: An opsin gene duplicated and diverged
We gained genes from other species
